| **Summary** | No Philosophical Forum-specific AI policy page could be located (its own forauthors.html could not be fetched directly, HTTP 402 on Wiley Online Library). Journal follows Wiley's publisher-wide Generative AI Guidelines: GenAI tools may not be listed as authors; any GenAI use in developing manuscript content must be disclosed transparently (Methods/disclosure/Acknowledgements); GenAI use to create/alter/manipulate original research data is prohibited; grammar/spelling tools are excluded from disclosure requirement. This is a publisher default, not confirmed as journal-tailored. |
| **Source URL** | https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/pb-assets/assets/15405885/Generative%20AI%20Policy_September%202023-1695231878293.pdf |

### Preprint Policy

> WO2 research note (not broken down per-stage — see docs/workorders/WO2_SOFT_METADATA_BATCH.md for why): Yes, under Wiley's general preprint policy: authors may post/retain the submitted (preprint) version on non-profit preprint servers at any time; the accepted (peer-reviewed) version may be self-archived after an embargo (24 months is the Wiley standard for social-science/humanities journals, which this title falls under). No Philosophical-Forum-specific preprint page was found, so this is inferred from publisher default, not a journal-specific statement.
> Source: https://authorservices.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/licensing-open-access/open-access/preprints-policy.html

**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** Journal explicitly positions itself (per current editor Alexus McLeod, since 2022) as bridging Western analytic and Continental philosophy with non-Western/global philosophical traditions - described as aiming to be 'a true global philosophical meeting place.' Long-standing tradition of single-topic/thematic issues (past examples cited: philosophy and economics, sociobiology, apartheid, African-American philosophical traditions, race and ethnicity) alongside general epistemology/ethics/consciousness/logic/metaphysics/philosophy of science/political philosophy/aesthetics submissions. Could NOT verify concrete 2024-2026 article titles or an active special-issue CFP - the Wiley table-of-contents page (onlinelibrary.wiley.com/loi/14679191) returned HTTP 402 and was not accessible via search snippets.

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** Analytic philosophy, Continental philosophy, Comparative / cross-tradition philosophy (non-Western traditions explicitly invited), Philosophy of science, Political philosophy, Aesthetics, Translations of non-Western philosophical texts (historically featured)
